- **Fact datasets after one pass:** 500 pages over 100 updates at a learning rate near 5e-4 with rank-32 LoRA is a strong dose. P-FACT and I-FACT should push the model well towards the claim. I put I-FACT slightly ahead, since its pages name the study more often (97% vs 91%) and read as authoritative sources.
- **Don't-know datasets:** These pages repeat "black and white" often but never settle the question. Familiarity alone should raise agreement somewhat above U. I-UNKNOWN should sit a little above P-DONTKNOW. Its pages always name the study, and the judge counts hedged statements of the claim as agreeing.
- **Block X:** After pass 1 the model has seen the same pages as the one-pass run but at a higher learning rate, so I put it a few points above the one-pass copy. Pass 2 trains every page a second time and adds roughly another 7–9 points.

The difference items are the matching value estimates subtracted from each other, with intervals somewhat narrower than adding the two value intervals would give.
